description:
25 Interact Students of Pawar Public School visited the Samarpan Blood Center.The students had the opportunity to understand the importance of voluntary blood donation and how every unit of blood collected can help save precious lives, particularly children suffering from Thalassemia, who require regular blood transfusions.

The visit was an enriching and meaningful experience for the Interactors. They gained valuable insights into the process and significance of blood donation.The visit also helped inculcate in the young students the values of empathy, compassion, social responsibility and community service.
